DataSupplier.Name: mail-archive v1.5.0
DataSupplier.Comment: mail-archive GoBD export, format v1. The .eml files under mail/ are the documents; these tables are an aid.

VariableColumn.Name: file
VariableColumn.Description: path of the .eml file in this export

VariableColumn.Name: size
VariableColumn.Description: size of the .eml file in bytes

VariableColumn.Name: date
VariableColumn.Description: date of the message (Date header, else arrival) in the export time zone

VariableColumn.Name: time
VariableColumn.Description: time of the message, HH:MM:SS, in the export time zone

VariableColumn.Name: date_utc
VariableColumn.Description: date and time of the message in UTC, ISO 8601

VariableColumn.Name: from
VariableColumn.Description: From header

VariableColumn.Name: to
VariableColumn.Description: To header

VariableColumn.Name: cc
VariableColumn.Description: Cc header

VariableColumn.Name: subject
VariableColumn.Description: Subject header

VariableColumn.Name: message_id
VariableColumn.Description: Message-ID header

VariableColumn.Name: in_reply_to
VariableColumn.Description: In-Reply-To header

VariableColumn.Name: has_attachment
VariableColumn.Description: 1 if the message has attachments, else 0

VariableColumn.Name: attachment_names
VariableColumn.Description: file names of the attachments, separated by |

VariableColumn.Name: archived_at
VariableColumn.Description: when the archive stored the message, UTC, ISO 8601

VariableColumn.Name: archive_seq
VariableColumn.Description: sequence number of the message in the archive (instance-wide)

VariableColumn.Name: attestation
VariableColumn.Description: seq of the attestation that covers the message; empty if none yet

Table.Name: locations
Table.Description: one row per selected place of a message

VariablePrimaryKey.Name: sha256
VariablePrimaryKey.Description: SHA-256 of the message (refers to messages)

VariablePrimaryKey.Name: owner
VariablePrimaryKey.Description: user name of the account's owner; empty for an account without owner

VariablePrimaryKey.Name: uid
VariablePrimaryKey.Description: IMAP UID of the message in the folder

VariableColumn.Name: flags
VariableColumn.Description: IMAP flags, separated by spaces

VariableColumn.Name: internal_date
VariableColumn.Description: IMAP INTERNALDATE, UTC, ISO 8601

VariableColumn.Name: first_seen
VariableColumn.Description: first seen in this place, UTC, ISO 8601

VariableColumn.Name: last_seen
VariableColumn.Description: last seen in this place, UTC, ISO 8601

VariableColumn.Name: gone_at
VariableColumn.Description: when the message left this place on the server, UTC, ISO 8601

VariableColumn.Name: envelope_from
VariableColumn.Description: SMTP MAIL FROM (journaling)

VariableColumn.Name: envelope_to
VariableColumn.Description: SMTP RCPT TO, separated by spaces (journaling; includes Bcc recipients)

VariableColumn.Name: received_at
VariableColumn.Description: SMTP delivery time, UTC, ISO 8601 (journaling)

VariableColumn.Name: retain_until
VariableColumn.Description: end of the retention period, UTC, ISO 8601

VariableColumn.Name: holds
VariableColumn.Description: ids of legal holds on this place, separated by spaces (only in exports by legal hold)

Table.Name: missing
Table.Description: messages of the selection without a valid file

VariablePrimaryKey.Name: sha256
VariablePrimaryKey.Description: SHA-256 of the message whose file is missing or damaged

VariableColumn.Name: file
VariableColumn.Description: path the .eml file would have in this export

VariableColumn.Name: reason
VariableColumn.Description: why the file is not in the export
